User.title: User
User.description: User profile with reality score and activity tracking

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

lastActive.description: Timestamp when the user was last active. Client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

skorRealitasTerakhir.description: Latest overall reality score between 0 and 100

Session.title: Session
Session.description: A Socratic cognitive diagnostic session with reality map, root causes, scenarios, and ZEBRA action

uid.description: Firebase Auth user ID of the session owner

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

diagnosis.description: AI Socratic analysis explaining the core issues

petaRealitas.description: 8-dimension reality scores: keuangan, keluarga, karier, relasi, tujuan, risiko, psikologi, kesehatan

analisisAkarMasalah.description: 4 contributing root causes leading to the core issue

skenario.description: Array of 3 scenarios: Stabil, Berani, Agresif

rekomendasiSkenario.description: AI recommendation of which scenario to pursue

zebra.description: Today's priority action: instruksi, dampakPoin, status (pending|done|failed)

evaluasiMingguan.description: Optional weekly evaluation: status, cerita, createdAt

createdAt.description: Timestamp of evaluation. Client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and latest reality score

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores full Socratic diagnosis sessions, scenarios, and ZEBRA actions
